confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Lima price levels. They were not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are less certain and vary a lot by district. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.1x and 1.7x, respectively), since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. FX is lower confidence: the only RBA-attributed figure found was 0.6979 USD per AUD dated 2026-10-09, reported by a third-party site (https://ozfinancehub.com.au/exchange-rates) that cites the RBA table. I did not open the rba.gov.au page to verify it, so it should be checked against the official RBA F11.1 table before use. An earlier search returned only RBA figures from March 2026, which are older.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a source. Anchors reflect general Latin American capital-city price levels, roughly in line with Bogota and Mexico City for everyday food and basic hotels. Upscale districts such as Miraflores and San Isidro are priced toward the higher end of the range.
